title: For creators
lead: A place for your community that costs your people nothing, works with your stream, and is quick to move into.

free.title: Free for everyone in it
free.text: Frames, profile effects, nameplates and name styles cost nothing. Nobody needs a subscription to stand out in your space.

tag.title: Your tag beside their names
tag.text: Give your space a tag. Members can wear it beside their name wherever this instance shows them, and a click on it leads to your space.

events.title: Events and watch parties
events.text: Plan streams and community nights as events with reminders, and watch videos together in a voice channel.

moderation.title: Room to moderate
moderation.text: Slow mode, word filters, timeouts, bans, join requests, and rules people agree to before they write.

twitch.title: Live on Twitch
twitch.text: Link your Twitch account in your settings. While you are live, your profile shows it, with a button to your stream.

streamerMode.title: Streamer mode
streamerMode.text: Hides email addresses, invite links and codes and what notifications say: by hand, with a shortcut, or by itself in the desktop app while OBS, Streamlabs or XSplit runs.

overlay.title: Voice overlay for OBS
overlay.text: Show who is in a voice channel and who is speaking in your stream: one link, added as a browser source.

camera.title: Camera backgrounds
camera.text: Blur your room or sit in a scene, made on your own device.

discord.title: Bring your Discord
discord.text: Copy your server's channels and roles from a template, and bring its emoji and stickers along.

invite.title: Your own invite address
invite.text: Give your space an address of its own, easy to put in a panel or a bio.

start.title: Ready in minutes
start.text: Create a space, give it a tag and an invite address, and share the link with your chat.

cta.title: Bring your community over
cta.text: Open Tavvit and create your space with the + at the top. Want a hand moving in, a creator badge or a verified space? Write to the team of this instance under Contact.
